'''Joe Mornout''' finished 2nd at the [[1999 GenCon Open]] and 6th at the [[1998 Corellia Regional (Indianapolis)]].<ref name="list-53912">[http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/53912 swccg-discussion message #53912], [[Alex Alcalde]] (31 July 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010509192606/http://groups.yahoo.com:80/group/swccg-discussion/message/53912 Internet Archive]</ref> He published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs.
